email_subject: Application - UX Specialist at Atlas Copco Group
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the UX Specialist role at Atlas Copco Group (VTBA). With a background in digital marketing, web development and analytics, I'm drawn to the opportunity to turn user insights into intuitive digital experiences.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I analyse user behaviour using Google Analytics and Search Console, and translate data into actionable improvements. I've built and optimized websites with a focus on usability, accessibility and structured data, and I regularly collaborate with content contributors to ensure relevance and customer focus. My technical skills in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, combined with experience in WordPress and Adobe tools, allow me to bridge design and implementation.

I'm proactive, hands-on and eager to learn in an international environment. I'd welcome the chance to contribute to Atlas Copco's digital customer experience.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the UX Specialist position at Atlas Copco Group (VTBA). Your focus on understanding customer interactions and turning insights into intuitive digital experiences resonates with my own approach to web and digital marketing.

In my freelance work and as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I've gained hands-on experience in analysing user behaviour using Google Analytics, Search Console and other tools, and translating that data into clear actions. For example, I built and optimized mirook.com, implementing structured data and running iterative technical audits that measurably improved the site's search health. I also manage content in WordPress, ensuring it is accessible and customer-focused, and collaborate with team members to keep existing content relevant.

My technical background in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, combined with experience in WordPress and design tools like Canva, allows me to bridge the gap between design and implementation. I'm proactive and take ownership of projects from analysis to reporting, always looking for practical solutions to improve the digital customer experience.

While I haven't used Hotjar or Power BI extensively, I'm a quick learner and eager to develop new skills. I thrive in dynamic, international environments and am fluent in English, with Turkish as my native language and a growing proficiency in Dutch.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to Atlas Copco's Communications team and help create engaging, customer-focused digital experiences. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Analysed user behaviour and website performance using Google Analytics and Search Console, translating data into actionable insights for SEO and usability improvements.
• Built and optimized websites with a focus on accessibility, structured data and customer-focused content, including mirook.com where technical audits measurably raised search health.
• Managed CMS content in WordPress, collaborating with contributors to ensure relevance and accessibility across client sites.
• Proactive and hands-on, taking ownership of projects from analysis to implementation and reporting, with a strong willingness to learn new tools.
• Fluent in English, native Turkish, with growing Dutch proficiency; experienced in international, remote team environments.
